Configuration Guide

This guide explains how to configure the NIST SP 800-22 Randomness Test Tool.

Application Configuration

Session Management

The application uses Redis for session management. Configure the following settings in app.py:

app.config['SESSION_TYPE'] = 'redis'
app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = 'your_secret_key'
app.config['SESSION_USE_SIGNER'] = True
app.config['SESSION_KEY_PREFIX'] = 'rtt:'
app.config['SESSION_REDIS'] = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379, db=0)
app.config['SESSION_PERMANENT'] = False
app.config['PERMANENT_SESSION_LIFETIME'] = timedelta(minutes=30)

Cookie Settings

Configure cookie security settings:

app.config['PREFERRED_URL_SCHEME'] = 'https'
app.config['SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE'] = 'Lax'
app.config['SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE'] = True
app.config['SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY'] = True
app.config['SESSION_COOKIE_PATH'] = '/'

File Management

Configure file storage settings:

APP_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
USER_FILES_DIR = '/tmp/rtt'
ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {'tar', 'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'bin', 'txt'}

Nginx Configuration

Basic Configuration

server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    server_name your_domain.com;

    ssl_certificate /path/to/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /path/to/key.pem;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:8000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    location /static {
        alias /path/to/web_app/static;
    }
}

SSL Configuration

For secure HTTPS connections:

  1. Obtain SSL certificates

  2. Configure SSL parameters:

ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
ssl_session_timeout 10m;

Security Settings

File Permissions

Set appropriate file permissions:

sudo chown -R $USER:$USER /tmp/rtt
chmod 755 /tmp/rtt
chmod 644 /tmp/rtt/*

Redis Configuration

Basic Settings

Configure Redis in /etc/redis/redis.conf:

bind 127.0.0.1
port 6379
requirepass your_redis_password
maxmemory 2gb
maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru

Security Settings

  1. Enable password protection

  2. Restrict network access

  3. Configure memory limits

  4. Set up persistence

Environment Variables

Required Variables

export FLASK_APP=web_app/app.py
export FLASK_ENV=production
export SECRET_KEY=your_secret_key
export REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0

Optional Variables

export MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=16777216  # 16MB
export UPLOAD_FOLDER=/tmp/rtt
export ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS=bin,txt,tar

Test Configuration

Default Parameters

Configure default test parameters in the application:

DEFAULT_TEST_PARAMS = {
    'blockFreq': 128,
    'blockNon': 9,
    'blockOver': 9,
    'blockApprox': 10,
    'blockSerial': 16,
    'blockLinear': 500,
    'secNum': 100,
    'secSize': 1000000
}

Test Selection

Configure available tests:

nist_test = [
    "Frequency",
    "BlockFrequency",
    "CumulativeSums",
    "Runs",
    "LongestRun",
    "Rank",
    "FFT",
    "NonOverlappingTemplate",
    "OverlappingTemplate",
    "Universal",
    "ApproximateEntropy",
    "RandomExcursions",
    "RandomExcursionsVariant",
    "Serial",
    "LinearComplexity"
]

Logging Configuration

Application Logs

Configure logging in app.py:

import logging

logging.basicConfig(
    filename='app.log',
    level=logging.INFO,
    format='%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'
)

Nginx Logs

Configure Nginx logging in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:

access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log combined buffer=512k flush=1m;
error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log warn;

Performance Tuning

Gunicorn Settings

Configure Gunicorn for optimal performance:

gunicorn -w 4 -b 127.0.0.1:8000 \
    --timeout 120 \
    --keep-alive 5 \
    --log-level info \
    --access-logfile /var/log/gunicorn/access.log \
    --error-logfile /var/log/gunicorn/error.log \
    web_app.app:app

Redis Optimization

Configure Redis for better performance:

maxmemory 2gb
maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
appendonly yes
appendfsync everysec
no-appendfsync-on-rewrite yes
auto-aof-rewrite-percentage 100
auto-aof-rewrite-min-size 64mb

Monitoring

System Monitoring

Set up monitoring tools:

  1. System metrics (CPU, memory, disk)

  2. Application metrics (requests, response times)

  3. Redis metrics (memory usage, connections)

  4. Nginx metrics (requests, errors)

Log Monitoring

Configure log monitoring:

  1. Application logs

  2. Nginx access logs

  3. Nginx error logs

  4. Redis logs

  5. System logs

Backup Configuration

File Backups

Configure backup strategy:

  1. Regular backups of: * Application files * Configuration files * User data * Test results

  2. Backup schedule: * Daily incremental backups * Weekly full backups * Monthly archives

Database Backups

For Redis data:

  1. Enable AOF persistence

  2. Configure RDB snapshots

  3. Set up backup schedule

  4. Test backup restoration
